concept: EKS: AWS Load Balancer Controller and Ingress → ALB
tests: How to expose multiple EKS services through a single load balancer, Kubernetes-natively, with TLS termination.
expected: The AWS Load Balancer Controller creates an ALB from Ingress resources: path/host-based routing to multiple services, TLS via ACM. Triggers: "EKS", "Kubernetes-native ingress", "single load balancer", "terminate TLS".
why_not: A Classic LB per service — expensive and unmanageable; a bare NLB with no ingress controller — no L7 routing; all services in one pod breaks microservices.
